title: Tim Taylor shows Grant the jump room building
summary: Grant Cameron tells of Tim Taylor shows Grant the jump room building, about 2013 at former aircraft building turned office complex, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: former aircraft building turned office complex

tellings.quote: And then he says, and then he says, oh, I don't remember, but he said, this is where the jump room was, or this is the jump, this is the story of the jump room.

plain: Grant Cameron, a longtime UFO researcher, says that in 2013 a man named Tim Taylor took him to a former aircraft building that had been turned into offices. He says Taylor told him this was where the "jump room" was, or where its story came from, a term the telling does not explain. Cameron tells it as a glimpse of a secret site tied to Taylor.
